user.title: Connect to S&P Connectair
user.description: [Sign in to Connectair]({authorization_url}) in a new tab and allow offline access. Copy the complete returned Connectair address, including its code= and state= query parameters, and paste it below. If S&P shows an Auth Error page, open your browser history and copy the preceding Connectair address containing code= and state=. Keep this address private: it contains a one-time login code. A renewable login is required.

data_description.refresh_token: Optional. Use only a private refresh token already issued for your Connectair account. Leave blank for normal sign-in.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Connectair again
reauth_confirm.description: [Sign in]({authorization_url}) using the same Connectair account. Copy the complete returned Connectair address, including its code= and state= query parameters, and paste it below. If S&P shows an Auth Error page, open your browser history and copy the preceding Connectair address containing code= and state=. Keep this address private: it contains a one-time login code.

data_description.refresh_token: Optional. Use only a private refresh token already issued for your Connectair account. Leave blank for normal sign-in.

error.invalid_auth: The login, callback or advanced refresh token is invalid or expired. Sign in again using the link above.
error.missing_refresh_token: S&P did not provide a renewable login. This integration cannot run unattended with an access token alone. Please enable offline access or contact S&P.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach S&P Connectair. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.invalid_response: S&P returned an unsupported response. Please report this issue without sharing login codes or tokens.

abort.already_configured: This Connectair account is already configured.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: Sign in using the same Connectair account as before.
